# Kanit

`gem.html` (ศึกอัญมณี) draws all of its text with Kanit, weights 600 and 800: the Thai and Latin subsets as woff2 in
`art/gem/font/` (four files, about 67 KB together), taken unchanged from the npm package `@fontsource/kanit` 5.3.0.

Kanit: https://github.com/cadsondemak/kanit
Copyright 2020 The Kanit Project Authors, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (see OFL.txt in this folder).
The licence allows using and shipping the font with a game; the font files must not be sold on their own.
